message.advancement_enhancement.no_serve: Server does not support advancement editing. Changes are visual only.
config.advancement_enhancement.title: Better Advancements Configuration
config.advancement_enhancement.doFade.to: Darkens the background behind advancements when hovering over an entry.
config.advancement_enhancement.criteriaD: How to show criteria requirements on hover. Default: Shows obtained. Spoiler: Shows unobtained. All: Shows both.
config.advancement_enhancement.requiresS: Require holding Shift to see criteria details.
config.advancement_enhancement.addToInve: Add a button to open advancements from the player inventory.
config.advancement_enhancement.showDebug: Shows internal GUI coordinates, useful for modpack makers aligning advancements.
config.advancement_enhancement.orderTabs: Sorts the top advancement tabs alphabetically.
config.advancement_enhancement.uiScaling: Scales the entire Better Advancements UI. Values below 50% might give odd results.
config.advancement_enhancement.onlyUseAb: Restricts tabs to only the top edge instead of wrapping around the screen.
config.advancement_enhancement.inventory: Whether the advancements shortcut in the inventory should be a Tab or a Button.
Adjust the horizontal position of the inventory button.
Adjust the vertical position of the inventory button.
config.advancement_enhancement.customInv: Resource location of a custom button background. Leave blank for vanilla.
Resource location for the button background when hovered. Leave blank to reuse the standard texture.
config.advancement_enhancement.enableEdi: Right click advancements to edit their properties and rearrange them (Requires OP to sync).
config.advancement_enhancement.drawArrow: Draws directional arrows on advancement lines.
config.advancement_enhancement.drawDirec: Draws direct straight/angled lines between advancements instead of the vanilla orthogonal lines.
config.advancement_enhancement.hideLines: Hides all connection lines between advancements.
config.advancement_enhancement.defaultCo: Color of the connection line when an advancement is completed.
config.advancement_enhancement.defaultUn: Color of the connection line when an advancement is locked/uncompleted.
config.advancement_enhancement.defaultCo: Color of the outer icon frame when an advancement is completed.
config.advancement_enhancement.defaultUn: Color of the outer icon frame when an advancement is locked.
config.advancement_enhancement.defaultCo: Color of the title banner when an advancement is completed.
config.advancement_enhancement.defaultUn: Color of the title banner when an advancement is locked.
